runtime.note: The production worker publishes immutable menu draw lists and the verified render-phase callback consumes them. Gameplay work drains on the existing game-thread hook. The live worker ignores runtime.cfg.

loader.note: Exact 01.010.002 production pins. The loader verifies target identity, version bytes, mapping bounds, write readback, and restoration before accepting this contract.

notes: Addresses are specific to normalized ELF SHA-256 2a3419b404a5d10f2d36d8056916e65afad6352b78489365e5f1003f8e953c0d and must be re-derived for any other build.

Worker-safe state changes and game-thread gameplay actions were validated on 01.010.002. Vehicle spawning includes cold-model streaming; the script-global vehicle-retention capability is demand-driven and was read back after activation.

The accepted renderer consumes immutable rectangle, text, sprite-preview, and Scaleform draw commands at the verified phase boundary. Exact hook and callback restoration are required during retirement.

validation.summary: Stable hidden-on-launch menu, navigation, previews and fallback, native glyphs, cold-model and MP/DLC vehicle spawning/retention, clean close, and clean Story Mode relaunch were observed on fresh game processes.
validation.limitations: Hardware acceptance applies to the recorded source artifacts. Rebuilt artifacts require a fresh on-hardware regression before distribution.

notes: This public manifest is the runtime target contract. Private derivation chronology and machine-local provenance are retained only on dev.
All addresses are specific to the normalized ELF SHA-256 recorded in binaryIdentity and must be re-derived for another build.
Production injection is ptrace-free and performs no permanent target credential or root elevation.
